title: code-growth config
description: What code-growth measures. Every key is optional; patterns are relative to the project root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to leave out of include. A bare folder takes its contents with it. Dotfiles and dot-folders are always left out.

include.description: Glob patterns to measure. A bare folder stands for everything inside it.

test.description: Glob patterns that pick the tests among what's measured, so the page can leave them out. A folder takes its contents with it.
